build_jet_nemotron_causal_lm: build a JetNemotronForCausalLM model with config and quantization config for causal language modeling
create_dynamic_short_convolution: create a DynamicShortConvolution module with kernel size and hidden size for dynamic 1D convolution
create_jet_block: create a JetBlock with config and layer id for fused recurrent gated delta rule attention
create_jet_nemotron_decoder_layer: create a JetNemotronDecoderLayer with config and layer id for attention and MLP blocks
load_jet_nemotron_weights: load weights into a JetNemotronForCausalLM model from an iterable of weight name and tensor pairs
